utterances.text: [Interpretation] The Trial Chamber will give a number to this photograph where the witness has shown us various projectiles. Can we have a number for the previous one, for the previous map?

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: I think that was 309, Your Honour, if I'm not mistaken. They're not marked.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It was 309, I'm told. For the record, let me note that the witness has shown by marking little dots on the hard copy, those spots on the wall that he had to fill in after the month of June, 1993, after the death of his wife.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Could I have the usher's assistance, please. I may need another bundle of these documents, the photo bundle which is P 09220, and I can -- I can assist you. For counsel, for the courtroom, I'm looking at Exhibit P 09220, and in particular -- excuse me. Photograph number 05016228. If you could put that on the ELMO, please, so everyone can see.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Sir, again, just have another vantage point. The arrow that's on that photograph, is that pointing to the back of your house?

utterances.speaker: DZEVAD HADZIZUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it does show it. It's the west side of my house.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Now, the structure with the -- to the immediate right of that large wall with -- there was a structure there with a peaked roof immediately to the right and above the arbour. Is it correct, sir, that in your testimony earlier today that's one of the buildings that you said was not at that location in June 1993?

utterances.speaker: DZEVAD HADZIZUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Now, if the usher still has there, please, Exhibit 308, IC 308, if we can look at that for a moment. I don't believe that's 308. 308 is a sketch, I believe. Sorry, Your Honour, it's a problem we don't have markings on the documents themselves; it becomes quite confusing for everyone. Sir, I'd like you to look at that document for a moment. I would also like you to have IC 297 next to it. If we could have -- if we could have, I'm sorry, for accuracy's sake, could I have the 297 that the registry has? IC 297, please. Thank you very much. On the ELMO as well. If I could have the other one, similar drawing back, just before it gets completely lost. Thank you very much. Now, sir, Mr. Praljak showed you a number of sketches and things quite quickly and had you make a number of markings on this drawing. You were showing at one point where your wife was standing and you made a number of arrows and markings to show where you believe, in response to various questions, your wife was standing or located at the time that she was shot. I don't know which of the lines or markings you thought you were making at the time, but the line that is -- looking at the line which is above the number 1 on the sketch that is there, the sketch which is IC 308, did you mean when you drew that line in looking also at the drawing that you marked -- the marking you made on 297, when you made the line above the number 1, did you mean to indicate the direction from which the shot came? Or what did you mean to indicate when you drew that?

utterances.speaker: DZEVAD HADZIZUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know what Mr. Praljak asked me, whether it's the -- where the bullet came from, but I see now it's not where the bullet came from. The bullet must have come from that side. That side was held by the HVO side. I don't know what I was showing; I was showing Hum or something. But the bullet must have come from this direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Can you make another marking on 308 where you believe the shot -- the direction the shot came from.

utterances.speaker: DZEVAD HADZIZUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It should be like this. From this direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... 3, at the top of the line where you just --

utterances.speaker: DZEVAD HADZIZUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: That's fine, number 3. Thank you very much, Witness. No further questions, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, Mr. Praljak. Further cross-examination by the Accused Praljak: THE ACCUSED PRALJAK: [Interpretation] Just one question, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: You showed that house at Stotina, you circled it a couple of times.

utterances.speaker: DZEVAD HADZIZUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: To the best of your knowledge, was one more floor added to it after the war?

utterances.speaker: DZEVAD HADZIZUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm not sure. Maybe, yes. Let me just tell you, I don't see Stotina anymore. Before the war I had visibility. I could see Stotina. I can't see it anymore because two more houses were added in front of me. Maybe another floor was added, maybe not. I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: You allow for the possibility that one more floor was added during the war? That's the information at least that I have. I'm just asking if you know something about it?

utterances.speaker: DZEVAD HADZIZUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: If that's what you claim, I take your word for it.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: We can see it on pictures. We can deal with it later.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] If you allow me, just one question for this witness arising from redirect.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] There are no questions after redirect unless you have a crucial, vital question. If it is not the case, you should not be asking the question, otherwise, I give you the floor.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Just if we can clarify one matter, sir.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It seems to me that you said, regarding those traces of bullets or shell, it seems to me you said that you had left your house before that, and that you don't know how they came about. Is that what you said?

utterances.speaker: DZEVAD HADZIZUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: That's all I wanted.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. Sir, I thank you very much for coming to The Hague to testify, especially since the events concerned are extremely painful to you and your whole family. On behalf of all the Judges, I wish to express our gratitude and wish you a safe trip back home. Rest assured that we have every sympathy for your feelings. I will now ask the usher to escort you out.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Back to the Prosecution now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We have around two hours left until the end of the day. We need to fit in a 20-minute break and we have three more witnesses. How did you plan to proceed? There are two possibilities. Either we speed up and we ask only questions about the point of origin of bullets, and that's what we want to know on the Bench. Everything else is secondary. If we just ask questions about where bullets came from, we can go very quickly. Mr. Scott.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Based on the experience yesterday and today, I don't think there is any way that we can possibly finish three witnesses yet today in the remaining time. We have less than two hours. I understand what the Court is indicating about the point of impact, but you can see we have just spent the last 45 minutes talking about where the shot came from and where -- what happened. So I see no -- I see no realistic possibility of finishing all witnesses and unfortunately with my apologies to the witnesses in advance.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] All the time that we are using is useful. If the investigation was carried out professionally, all these questions have been resolved and evidence exists. However, we see that there are certain lacunae that the Trial Chamber has to fill in order to establish the truth. So it is not the fault of the Trial Chamber. You also have done what you could, but certain elements are missing.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Your Honour, I apologise. I didn't mean to suggest that the -- the burden fell entirely on the Trial Chamber for the time used. Everyone has used a great deal of time. Mr. Praljak has used a great deal of time. I had to come back on redirect and use more time than usual. That's just the way it has worked out. I wasn't casting any stones in any direction at all. It's just simply, I don't think we can realistically conclude three remaining witnesses today, unfortunately.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] So which witness do you want brought in right now?

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Your Honour, Mr. Bos will be taking the next witness, and I'm not sure if he is a protected witness or not, to be perfectly honest. You will have to check.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] From all I know, there are no applications.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Mr. Heljic, Your Honour, will be the next witness. Mr. Bos will be taking the witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. We are going to bring in Mr. Heljic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: While that is happening, Your Honour, if I may just briefly make an observation for the record, which I'm sure has not gone unnoticed on the Trial Chamber. All of these photographs that we seem to be showing to the witnesses are not a fair and accurate representation of the scene at the time that the incident occurred. We don't know exactly what the scene looked like at the time. That puts us at a great disadvantage to simply say that a building went up, I had -- I had this particular view, is insufficient for any -- anybody, including this expert who is going to come in and say to any degree of scientific certainty that a shot came from a particular place at a particular time from a particular weapon. I raise this because I think perhaps we may be able to shorten the proceedings by recognising that one, what is being shown to the witnesses are photographs that are not fair and accurate representations and, therefore, the best that we could do is guess. That being said, it would appear that if we applied the standard of proof, proof beyond a reasonable doubt, then I think in all instances, the Trial Chamber must find that the Prosecution is unable to prove beyond a reasonable doubt as to where the shot came from and accordingly who was the shooter and under whom that shooter was under control. Therefore, we might be able to just dispense with this entire line of testimony and save some time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Scott.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... it's clear, and it's very clear --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Just a minute. I thought that the usher had gone out to bring in the witness. Please go and bring the witness. Continue, Mr. Scott.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. I think it's very clear, and it's -- there's been no effort, of course and I don't -- I hope Mr. Karnavas is not suggesting this, there has been no effort to deceive or misguide the Court in this way. It's been very clear from the beginning, from the witnesses who have said when these photographs were made, when this 360 was done, the buildings that were there are not there. Unfortunately there is only so much the Prosecution can do under the circumstances. We cannot go back to 1993 and create photos that didn't exist at the time. All we can do is explain that to the Chamber. I have to say that I don't want to be rushed because I do want to respond to counsel's comments for the record and make sure it's clear. I think it's a bit of an overstatement to say that that characterises the entirety of the Prosecution evidence. Some of the photographs do, we think, look virtually the same as they did in 1993, and some of the sites. Some of them don't. But we have pointed that out to the Chamber and tried to provide the Chamber as much information as possible. Of course at the end of the day, the Chamber will have to decide based on the totality of the evidence before it. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] All the parties can rest assured that the Chamber reviews every case very scrupulously. You have to bear that in mind, and you can rest assured that the conclusion on every incident in our judgement will be explained in detail. We are trying to work, however, with indisputable and certain elements and rely on them in the first place. Witness, can you hear me in the language you understand?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I do.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Stand up now, please. I have to ask you to give me your full name and date of birth.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Anel Heljic, 16 December 1983.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] What is your current occupation, if any?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I am not employed.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Have you testified before a court of law earlier on the events that happened in your country, or is this the first time?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The first time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Now, please read the solemn declaration that is being given to you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I solemnly declare that I will speak the truth, the whole truth and nothing but the truth.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Just a few brief words of explanation before I give the floor to the Prosecution. You can sit. You will now be questioned by the Prosecution and you have met representatives of the Prosecution before. They will be showing you documents, maps, maybe videos, and after that time, which should be no more than 30 minutes, it will be the turn of the Defence who will have one hour in total to ask you relevant questions. And the Judges also of course will be able to ask you questions. Mr. Bos, proceed, and we are bearing in mind the contents of his written statement.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. Good morning, everyone. Good morning, Witness. I will first read out the Rule 65 ter summary of this witness. The witness, a nine-year-old boy, lived in Donja Mahala, Mostar. Sometime in the first half of June 1993, the witness was playing on the street with his two friends. On that day between 4.00 and 5.00, Mustafa Buric, a truck driver, took the witness and his two friends on his water tanker to the apartment building situated at Gojka Vukovica 118, where he parked his truck behind a Volkswagen Golf. Mustafa Buric left the truck while the witness and his friends remained in the front seat of the truck. A minute after Mustafa Buric had left the truck, the witness heard the sound of flying bullets impacting on the surface of the streets, approximately a metre and a half in front of the Volkswagen Golf. A couple of seconds later, he heard the sound of a second bullet, which impacted in either the motor hood or the front windshield of the Volkswagen Golf. Five or six seconds later, a second shot had been fired -- the second shot had been fired. The witness heard something fly through the front windshield of the truck and smelled gunpowder. This third shot had hit and wounded him in the right upper arm. After the third shot had hit the truck, all three of them tried to get out at the same time. The witness managed to get into the apartment building, his friend Nihad Buric was slightly wounded on the left side of his chest. According to what the witness heard later, he must have been hit by a fragmentation bullet because he had one entry wound and two exit wounds. The witness had to undergo surgery in the war hospital and had to stay there for about three months. In total, it took about a year to recover. According to the witness, the shots must have been fired from the direction of the HVO positions at Stotina, which was about 600 metres away and on a higher elevation from where the truck was parked.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Witness, I just summarised your statement and I am going to ask you a few questions about your written statement. Did you provide a written statement to the investigators of the Office of the Prosecutor on the 29th of August, 2001?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And at the time you provided this written statement, did you answer the questions of the investigator truthfully?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Truthfully and correctly.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And did you answer the questions freely, that is without any coercions?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, freely.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And at the conclusion of that interview, sir, was your statement read back to you in the Bosnian language?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And did you then sign the statement in the English language?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: I'm now going to provide you with your statements with the assistance of the usher. Could you take a look at the first document in this bundle and see whether you recognise your signature on the -- on the English statement in this bundle. This is Exhibit 9860. You will see a little -- in the bundle there is a -- a number there, 9860. Would you look into this and see.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Is that -- do you now have the English statement in front of you?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Is that your signature which is on the statement, Witness?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, it is.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Witness, do you recall that you met with an investigator and myself yesterday afternoon?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I recall that.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And at that meeting do you remember that I asked you whether you wanted to make any corrections to your statement?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I remember being asked that.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And is it true that you indicated one specific correction relating to the bright-coloured clothing of yourself and your friends, which is on the fourth paragraph of page 2 of your statement? If you want to look at the B/C/S version, if you continue, you will find your statement into -- in the B/C/S language. Let me just ask you this: Do you remember that -- that you wanted to make a correction in relation to the clothing of you and your friends. What was the correction you wanted to make?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I remember that. The correction had to do with our T-shirts. In fact, the T-shirts of my friends.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And what was the correction that you wanted to make?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: What was written was that my friends were wearing multi-coloured shirts.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: If you want to find the passage, it's on the second page of --

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, yes, I found it. It says all the three of us were in children's clothing of bright colours.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Let me just ask, what was the clothing that you were wearing that day?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I remember about myself, I was wearing a light green shirt with long sleeves and it had a Mickey Mouse on it.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And do you remember what your two friends were wearing that day?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I really can't remember now. I was a child.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And is that the correction that you wanted to make to the statement? Because here you said that they were also wearing bright coloured clothing.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Only that, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Witness, one other thing. In your statement you say that you can't remember the exact date that the incident occurred, and you talk about the half -- around half June 1993. Now, is it correct that yesterday you said that you remembered the exact date?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I remember that, because I got a paper from the hospital where it is written that I was hit on the 13th.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And did I ask you whether you had that document with you yesterday in proofing?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I said I had it at home.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: You had it at home. So is it correct that last night you tried to contact your parents and find out whether they still had the document which says that -- which confirmed that it would have been on the 13th of June?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, they said that was the date, but that paper had been submitted as part of the documentation required for an application for some sort of civilian pension.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Witness, we have lost a lot of time on Mickey Mouse T-shirts and the clothing of your friends. Just one question that I wanted to ask to save time. Mustafa, the driver of this water cistern, how was he dressed, if you can recollect?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I don't remember.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Your Honours, could I just ask when we would have the break because I know we have been going on for one and a half hours now. Would this be a good time or would you like me to continue?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. I see the clock, and we are going to take the break now. It's noon now, and we resume in 20 minutes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The hearing is resumed, Mr. Bos.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Witness, do you remember in 2004 that you met with an investigator and a photographer at the ICTY in Mostar, in the summer of 2004?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I do remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And at that time were you asked a series of questions relating to the sniping incident discussed in your statement?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And were these questions and answers videotaped?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Can you repeat the question, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: When you were asked these questions and you were giving answers, was this videotaped? Do you recall that?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, it was taped.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Witness, we are now going to play a videotape, and, in fact, we're going to play two videotapes Your Honours. And first we will show the two videoclips and then afterwards I will ask you a few questions, Witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: "Investigator: Mr. Buric, to the best of your recollection, is this the proximity to the one in which your son, Nihad Buric and his friend Anel Heljic were shot at around the 6th or 7th of June 1993? "Witness: Yes. "Investigator: Mr. Buric, to the best of your recollection, could you indicate where a bullet had gone through the windscreen of the truck at that time. "Witness: Yes, I can. "Investigator: Please indicate. "Witness: [Witness indicates] "Investigator: I will now measure the height from the ground to where the bullet impacted the windscreen. For the recording purposes, the height was two metres and 20 centimetres."

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: We can play the next clip as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Your Honour, just before we do that, could just for the record, can it be established whether the truck we saw in the video was the same one or the same model truck as was involved in the actual incident, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Your Honours, I was going to ask questions about that after playing this video. If you wish, I can ask the questions now, but I prefer to show this video first and then ask the questions, if that's okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: "Investigator: Mr. Heljic, to the best of your recollection, could you please point out the position where the water truck in which you were shot at was parked? "Witness: [Indicates] "Investigator: To the best of your recollection, could you please point out at the spot where you saw the first bullet impact on the surface of the street. "Witness: [Indicates] "Investigator: To the best of your recollection, could you please point at the spot where you saw the second bullet impact the yellow Volkswagen Golf? "Witness: [Indicates] "Investigator: To the best of your recollection, could you please show where the third bullet hit you. "Witness: [Indicates] "Investigator: To the best of your recollection, was that house that we see over there, was that house already built at the time when you were shot at? "Witness: No. "Investigator: I will now mark a yellow X in the position where the witness indicated that the water truck was parked."

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Witness, let me just a few questions first on the last clip that you saw. Did you recognise yourself on this -- on this videoclip?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And did you understand the questions that were put to you by the investigator.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, of course.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And did you answer them truthfully to the best of your knowledge?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Only the truth.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Now, a couple of questions about the first videoclip, and maybe we can just show the image as a stand still on the screen of the first clip. Yeah, we can stop it here. Witness, do you recognise the man who is answering the questions to the investigator on this clip?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Who is he?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Mustafa Buric.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And was Mustafa Buric the man who actually parked the water truck at the spot that you had indicated on the video that was played after this?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, of course.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Witness, we see a blue truck behind there. Was this the actual blue truck that you -- that were you in when you were shot at? Is this the same truck?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: No. The colour and the truck are the same, or type of truck, but it's not that same truck.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Very well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Prosecutor, I apologise. But to go back to the truck. Witness, the truck with what it has there on the top is blue. At the time, was this type of truck used by the police and army, given what the truck has at the top there, that round ...

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I don't know. This is a water truck. This is a water truck used for water.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And in 1993, Witness, was this truck also used for water?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Buric is indicating a spot where the bullet entered the -- the -- the -- the front of the truck. And maybe we can play it again. And I would like to ask you, would you agree with what he points at as the -- location where the bullet impacted? Maybe we can play the videotape again.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I agree.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Let's play the tape and maybe we can stop at the point where he is indicating the impact.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: "Investigator: Mr. Buric, to the best of your recollection, could you indicate where the bullet had gone through the windscreen of the truck at that time? "Witness: Yes, I can. "Investigator: Please indicate that. "Witness: [Indicates]"

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: You can stop there, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: So would you agree with him that that would be the approximate location, spot?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I agree.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And maybe just while we have the image here, could you tell us where you were actually seated in the truck at this time? Were you seated on the left, in the middle or on the right?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Right next to the driver.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Maybe -- I don't know if you can indicate it. So on the right-hand side or on the left?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Looking at it this way, then it's on the right.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: So would it be on the far end right of -- of the seats?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Now perhaps the witness could show us with a pencil on the photographer where he was.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Your Honours, we have a photograph. I don't have it right here at hand, but I will see to it that we get the photograph and then he can mark the spot later on. It will take five minutes to get the photograph because I don't have it here. I'll come back to that.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Witness, we'll come back to -- to this photograph and then you can mark the exact spot, but let me ask you first, is it correct that yesterday when we met that you were shown a 360-degree photograph?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I was shown one.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And is it correct that when we were showing you this photograph that I asked you to indicate the exact spot where you think that the shots on that day came from? On this 360 photograph?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I showed you the direction they came from.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Now, Witness, we're going to again show this 360-degree photograph in court now, and we'll make a full turn. And what I would like you to do is to say "stop" when you actually have the direction from which you think the shots came from in sight. Would you be able to do that? So we'll start and we'll make a right-hand turn and make a full turn and then please say "stop" when you actually see the site. So let's first make a turn.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Stop.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: You want it to stop here? Or you want it to move a bit left or right or is this okay?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: A little more to the right. Stop.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Witness, we made a video still. Yesterday you indicated the same spot, and we made a video still of this, which we will now put on the -- on the ELMO. Now, could I ask you to -- with a marker, could I ask you to mark the spot where you -- the spot where you think that the shots came from.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Could you put a 1 over there as well, a number 1.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Now, you've marked the spot right on top of a tree. Was this tree there in 1993?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, it was, but it was narrower and you could see more.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And what was it you could actually see behind that tree?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: You could see two houses at Stotina.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And is it your testimony that you think that these shots came from Stotina?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, of course.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Witness, while you and your friends were in the truck, were you able to hear where these shots came from? Because you heard, in fact, there were three shots?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: You could hear it but it wasn't that loud.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And were you able to see anything?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I think we saw the second bullet, and just fire from a room. And we all talked about it, that he must have shot from there.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: What is it exactly that you saw when you say they just fire from a room. Can you be a bit more specific? What was it that you saw?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Or a blaze, a blaze coming from that premises. I don't know how to explain. Something shone.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Sir, I understand what you were saying. You heard something shine from the room. Now, my question is what house? House opposite you? You placed a circle where the tree is, on the tree. So with respect to the truck and your friend sitting in front of the truck, I'm trying to position on the photograph and imagine the house where this flash came from. Could you use your pen to indicate that house?

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Your Honours, I'm going to show the witness a few more photographs which hopefully will clarify this question. I have two more photographs.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. Let's try and make things clear straight away.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: If we could just get an IC number for this photograph, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Number, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this becomes IC number 310.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Witness, do you recognise what is depicted on this photograph?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And what -- what are we seeing here?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I can see the two houses that I mentioned a moment ago as being there on the hill.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Could you again take the marker and put a circle around the houses you have been referring to?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Witness, you have put a small circle around -- on one particular house. You just said there were two houses and now you put a circle around -- are you talking about houses or windows now, because this -- this is a ...

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I'm talking about the house.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: So was this the house that -- from which you saw this blaze or glaze?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And in 1993, did the house look exactly as it looks here on this picture?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, except that the upper floor didn't exist.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: I have one other photograph, and maybe again could we have an IC number for this photograph? And witness, could you please put your initials where you --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] IC number, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this becomes IC number 311.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And Witness, could you --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Just a moment, please. Witness, put your initials on the photograph, on the document, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] A technical question from me. We can see this photograph with quite a number of houses, and you drew a small circle on one of those houses. Now, that location, what was it called generally, that area?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Stotina.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. So that locality, when you were small, because you were nine at the time, did you know the area well? Did you play there? Do you know the area well?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I didn't play there, but I did know it. I went there from time to time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Were you there quite a number of times?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Well, I can't say exactly, but I was there, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] At the time, the day you were hit, did you know that there was a conflict going on between the HVO and the BH Army?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, I did not know.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You didn't know that there was shooting that was going on in that district or in the town you lived in?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I knew that there was shooting, but I didn't know -- well, where we were in my street, everything was normal. We would walk around, play there.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well, thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Could you please put your initials on this photograph that is still on the ELMO. Okay. And this one, just in the right-hand corner, put your initials, Witness, on the photograph with a marker. Then we know you were the one who marked the photograph. Could you please put your initials in the right-hand corner of the photograph, Witness.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And also on the next photograph. There is one other photograph which he has to put -- okay. Witness, this photograph I was about to show you, again, do you recognise what's being depicted on this photograph?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I do recognise that.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And can you put a marker and -- a circle around the house where you think that the blaze came from in this photograph?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And can we get an IC number for this photograph, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this becomes IC 312.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Now, if we could just now go back to the truck. This is Exhibit P 09220, page number 6, for e-court purposes.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: So, Witness, this photograph will appear on your screen, and again you will be able to mark it, this time with another marker. So it's Exhibit P 09220, page number 6. So, Witness, here we see the same photograph again that we saw before. And could you please mark with the pen that will be given to you by the usher the position of -- the place where you were seated when you were shot at?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Thank you. And again maybe if could you put your initials in the right-hand corner of the photograph and get an IC number for this?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] IC number, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this will be IC 313.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Your Honour, with the last witness, Mr. Scott made an objection to diagrams being used that were not to scale. And here we still have not received foundation that this truck actually has the same or similar dimensions to the one that was involved in the incident. Sorry to press the point. The witness gave a vague answer saying it was the same type of truck. What we don't know -- the issue I raised was whether it was the same model in terms of design, year of manufacture and so on. And the only relevance is that if the Prosecution is going to make something of the precise measurements, it may be of use to the expert in some way, then it's important to know.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We're going to ask him the question. Witness, we see this truck, and we see the emblem of that famous car. Is this truck the same model as the one in which you were at the moment when you were injured?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, it's completely the same.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Murphy, he says completely the same.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... take it further. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Witness, I'm going to show you one more photograph, and then I'm done. We can put this on the ELMO. Do you recognise the picture on the ELMO, Witness?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I recognise it.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: What is it?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: It's my arm showing the trace of the wound from the bullet.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: And is this where the bullet actually entered your arm, or where it exited your arm?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: No, it's the entry wound.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: If we can get an IC number for this photograph and then I'm done with my questions, Your Honour?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] IC number, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this is IC number 314.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Thank you, Witness. That concludes my questions.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Witness, before we give the floor to the Defence, I have one last question. In your statement you say that your friend Nihad Buric had also been hit, although lightly. And you had three whizzes of the bullet. According to what you saw, was your friend hit by the same bullet or was everybody hit by a separate bullet? And lastly, were there casings found? Were the bullets found?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Nihad Buric and I were hit by the same bullet, the third one. And the bullets were found. Fragments were found in my arm, my mother put that away somewhere and even fragments, particles of the shirt were extracted from my arm. That's all I can tell you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Mundis and Mr. Bos, we just heard what the witness said. His mother put what was extracted away somewhere. I would have asked the witness to have brought -- to bring that. But maybe he wasn't asked about it. Maybe you didn't know about it.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: No, Your Honours, we didn't ask the witness about this. And -- well, we could ask the witness now.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Witness, do you still have these fragments?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Whenever I asked my mother, she told me she had thrown it away, because she doesn't like to remember.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PRANDLER
utterances.text: Mr. Heljic, I would like to ask you a question, which as a matter of fact relates to the very last topic, what we have been talking about. It is the question of the fragmentation bullet, and now you told us that the remnants of that fragmentation bullet was in a way first taken by your mother, but then it was thrown away. You also mentioned in your statement that -- and I quote, "According to what I heard later, it must -- I must have been hit by a fragmentation bullet." Now, my question is, if you remember that in the medical statement what you have received after your stay in the hospital, if the fragmentation bullet was mentioned there or not, and I heard Mr. Bos asking you about the statement which remained at home. Because it would be important to really know if it was a bullet, a fragmentation bullet or it was a simple one, and we -- we have here before our eyes a picture of -- a photo of your arm with the entry wound, but I wonder, and probably Mr. Bos will be able to tell us if you have another photo on the other side where the exit wounds could have been shown. Probably it would be also useful to know. It is my question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Bos, you are going to answer, but I want to go straight to the point. Witness, look at me, please. We saw a photo of your arm. Is it the case that on the back of your arm there is an exit wound, or maybe you have only one wound.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] There are two holes out in the back.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Your Honours, we don't have a photograph of -- of the exit wounds, but since the witness is here and if it may be worthwhile, that the witness would show his arm and show the exit wounds. I don't know the best way to do it, maybe we can have it put on a camera and we can make a still of it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Witness, would you -- can we bother you to show us your arm, if -- if you mind then you don't have to, but as you wish.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It doesn't matter to me. I'd like you to see.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Then show us. Pull off your top and show us your arm.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Indicates]

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: Your Honours, I suggest that we try to catch it on the camera, so that we have it on the camera.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Indicates]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I note that his arm is deformed and on the back of the arm there are -- there is at least one exit wound. Now move, change position. Yes, we see two exit wounds, the traces of two exit wounds. And can we see the front again? Could you turn around again so that we see the exit -- the entry wound again? Turn, please. Right. Good. Thank you. You can put your top back on. Very well. The Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Our time has been placed at the disposal of other teams.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The Registrar just told me that we will have photos, so we are going to assign IC numbers to photos of the arm of the injured part.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, the two pictures will get one IC number 315.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Next counsel.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. We have no questions for the gentleman, but we wish to thank him for coming here to give his evidence. Thank you, sir.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Next counsel. Thank you, Mr. Karnavas.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Just one or two very quick matters. If we could please, with the assistance of the Registrar, have Prosecution Exhibit 9220 back again, the page 6, the picture of the blue truck. 9220, page 6.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. Heljic.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: While the -- while the photograph is coming up on the screen and -- oh, here it is. You indicated that you -- when you were shot you were sitting down in the front passenger seat of the truck; is that right?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: And do you remember, roughly, how tall you were when you were nine years old?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I don't remember exactly, but I was small.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: When you say small, you mean small for your age, small for a nine-year-old?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Right.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: But you don't remember even approximately how tall?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: All right. Now, you said that the truck that we see in the photograph here was exactly the same model as the one involved in the incident. Are you saying that the -- that in the city of Mostar, they are using the same fleet of water trucks that they were using in 1993, the same vehicles are still on the road?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I don't know what to answer, but it was the same truck. That much I know. The model is the same, everything is the same. I know that because sometime later I was in that truck, and I thought they were actually photographing that very same truck.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: When you say "sometime later," when was that that you thought you were in the same truck again?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Well, after perhaps three, four years. Because the truck was lying there for a long time.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Well, what I'm trying to ask you is, does the city of Mostar, like most cities, replace its trucks from time to time and get newer models?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Well, I cannot tell you that with any certainty. But they do change, the company has changed.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Well, it seems from the -- the device on the front of this truck, that it's a Mercedes truck of some kind; is that right?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Do you remember whether that Mercedes symbol was on the front of the truck the day you were shot?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I remember that because I like Mercedes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Do you know the -- the name or the number of the model truck?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: No, I don't.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: So you -- would this be fair, that you can't really tell us whether there might have been some change of model between 1993 and 2004; is that right?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: I have nothing further, Mr. President. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Your Honour, with your leave, Mr. Praljak will have some questions and then I will have some, I presume.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Praljak. THE ACCUSED PRALJAK: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I would like to clear up some technical matters as usual. Cross-examination by the Accused Praljak:

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Witness.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: I'm really sorry this happened to you, and I'm sorry, but I do have to ask you a couple of questions in order to get nearer to the truth because the truth is what we are seeking. Can I ask the usher to bring -- to take those photos to the ELMO. Just one small detail. On the right-hand side it says that this truck is not a Mercedes, it is an FAP truck, somebody just put a Mercedes emblem on it. Can you read for us what is written there, if you can see it?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I can see, it's written FAP famos.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: But since everybody likes Mercedes, somebody put a Mercedes emblem on it. Do you agree with me? It's just a small detail, but we have to be careful about detail. Since you are there and we have a couple of photographs, I would like us to review them together very carefully. Can we please see the first one? On the ELMO, please. Here we have the first photograph on the ELMO. In the right bottom corner you just showed us a house and you said a moment ago one floor was added to it. Do you see it?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Can you mark it with number 1, please.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: A larger -- a larger 1, please.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Now, below, do you see those two houses, they're called Sokol buildings in Mostar. Behind those two houses in the direction of the Neretva, do you see the mosque and then the two houses in front of the mosque? The truck was outside these houses when you were shot. According to all available information, the truck was standing outside those two buildings. Do you see the mosque, the road goes down the Neretva, and then we see there's two twin buildings. I'm not rushing you.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I can't find -- I can't understand this picture. It's a bit strange.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Well, next to these trees, those little fir trees and --

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I think it's here, where the ...

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Do you recognise it? Do you know about these two buildings?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: The truck was standing not on this side of the buildings that we see, but on the opposite side, closer to the road; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Was the truck standing outside the first building, the one that is closer to us, or the other one?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: The one that is closer to us.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Because later we'll have a problem with the expert who drew the truck as standing outside the second building. This photograph was taken from higher up, from Stotina. Mark the first building outside of which you believe the truck to have been standing.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: So the truck was behind that building. Thank you. Now, place your signature and we'll get an IC number after that.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Witness, based on this photo, you marked 1 on the house, from which the shot came, and you put number 2 at the spot where the truck was parked. Is that the case?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. THE ACCUSED PRALJAK: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Do you agree with me, sir, that the road where the truck was parked is between the road and -- between that building and the Neretva River? Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Correct. But I have the impression that this is on old photograph.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Never mind that. Let's take the second picture. This is the street where the truck was standing, next to the pavement and this is precisely the building you marked a moment ago. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: That's the first building, and there is another one closer to us. Can you mark this building with 1.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: And mark the spot where you remember the Golf car to have been parked and also the spot of the truck.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Which one do you want first?

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Golf.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: And put number 2 there.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: And now closer to us, is that where the truck was?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Then put an X and 3.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: And your signature.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks].

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] IC number, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: THE ACCUSED PRALJAK: [Interpretation] We have an IC number. Maybe we don't have an IC number for the previous one.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Then the previous one. IC number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this is IC number 316. THE ACCUSED PRALJAK: [Interpretation] For the second one.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And this one now.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: This will be IC number 317. THE ACCUSED PRALJAK: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Can we put back the previous one for a second longer. These buildings up front in the distance, they are not at Stotina, they are buildings on the street, right?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Right.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Can you mark them with number 4?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: They are in the same street, aren't they?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: They are.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Next photograph, please. You see, I tried to film this from Stotina, and again you see the mosque, left centre, and these two buildings next to the cypress trees, are those the same buildings we have discussed before?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Put a number 1 on there.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: So these are the two buildings. Can we agree that the truck was outside one of them, the question is which one. The truck was on the right-hand side of that building, behind?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Now, draw an arrow to show where the truck would have been.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: That's a building.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Behind that building.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Behind the building. Then mark this photo with your signature.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: This apartment block that you see here, it all existed before the war. You were young then, but that existed before the war, there's nothing new now?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: But the two buildings that I just marked up front were not there.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: And what about these?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Which one wasn't there, according to you? These are -- the buildings of the aluminum combine. Which ones do you believe were built later, if you know?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I know some were built later, but I don't know exactly which, because it was Switzerland that financed the renovation and rebuilding of some of these.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: I'm not talking about repairs. Those buildings existed, they were quite damaged, and they had burnt, and they were repaired. But they existed while you were a child?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: They did not exist. Maybe building had started before the war, but they are finished -- they were finished only now.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Was the frame of the buildings already complete, the concrete walls, the roof, et cetera?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Some of it had been done, but not -- not all that, because I used to play inside, you know.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: All right. Next photograph.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] IC number for the photo.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: This will be IC number 318, Your Honours. THE ACCUSED PRALJAK: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: It's the same photograph but taken closer up. So could you mark the building again to the right of which was the truck. Put a 1 there.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Thank you. And now tell me, these other buildings in front of that one, but just stop to think a little, when you were a child, were those buildings the way we see them now as structures, whether they were in a poor state or not, that's different, but were they standing the way they are now to the best of your recollections? If you don't remember, then never mind.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: As far as I remember, I don't think they were this high, and you couldn't live in them. The construction work had stopped halfway. Because we took some plastic pipes away from the buildings. We --

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Had the roof been constructed or not?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Are you sure about that?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I remember because I actually fell from one of those buildings.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: How many floors did they have? How many storeys would you say was there? There was just the roof that was lacking or were there less floors?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Perhaps one or two floors but not as tall and there was still no roof.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: All right. Let's have an IC number for the photograph and you put your initials.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] A number, please, Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: This becomes IC number 319. THE ACCUSED PRALJAK: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Once again a view from Stotina. A broader view, and we can see that building again. Please mark it once again. This is an important issue, so I have to keep asking you to look at the photographs. I'm afraid I have been unsuccessful in providing an optic vision of this, and it's a pity that the Prosecutor didn't put the model of a truck somewhere around there to -- first to be able to locate it, so could you put a number 1.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Thank you. And tell us where the street towards the right was where the truck was, just put an arrow.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Thank you. And that would be number 2. A number 2, please. Yes. Number 2 by the arrow, please.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: And your signature at the bottom.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: And an IC number, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] An IC number, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this will be IC number 320. THE ACCUSED PRALJAK: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Young man, when you go up to Stotina or when you did then or now, from the edge of Stotina, can you see -- would you be able to see what this photograph depicts? Is that a good view?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, but this is right down low by the motorway.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Well, look at the rooftops. We wouldn't be able to see the rooftops if we were right down on the level of the motorway. So just take a moment to think, when you were up at Stotina, could you have a view of this kind?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: This is a good view, but it's a little lower than you would be looking at.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: All right. Just put a number 1 by the house where the truck was and sign at the bottom, please.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: You were a young child, you don't remember, but -- IC number, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this will be IC number 321. THE ACCUSED PRALJAK: [Interpretation] May we have that photograph on our screens for a while yet.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: You said you didn't know about the war, you played out in the streets and so on. Did you know that at that time there were soldiers there, BH Army soldiers and that there were separation lines or anything like that, do you know anything about any of those things?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Well, very little.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: All right. One more photograph please and that will be the last one. I won't trouble you anymore. This is taken exactly from Stotina. It wasn't lower down or anything. Is that when you were up on Stotina, is that what you would see from this angle?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Well, yes, it is, but once again it seems that the person taking the photograph climbed lower down. It's not up by the house, it was higher up.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: This is exactly in front of the house, but moved forward a little bit. So the person wasn't lower down. It's the view, but you don't have to agree with me on that point. We'll deal with that with the expert. Just mark the building once again, please, with the number 1.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: And can you see the building in front of that number 1 building? Do you remember that that house was standing at that time? There are a lot of films about that and of course we will give evidence about that later, but do you know that that house was in that location at that time?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I don't know. I told you --

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Yes, I understand you. Thank you for your effort. I'm sorry for having to ask you these questions. And may I have an IC number for that photograph.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Put your initials on the photograph and we'll have an IC number. Mr. Kovacic, useful, necessary and relevant questions, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this becomes IC number 322.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Kovacic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Witness. Before -- or rather, earlier on in response to the Prosecution's questions, you were showed Vukovic street and the place where the truck was standing and you were asked about the house behind the trees and you said that it was a new house built after the events.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Thank you. You didn't live in Gojka Vukovica Street, did you, where you were wounded?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I did live on Gojka Vukovica Street, but a little further up, not there.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: How far away, roughly? How much further?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Well, 100, 200 metres.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Does that mean that you consider that you knew this part of the street well?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, I knew it well.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Very well, thank you. You also said today when you were asked where you were sitting in the cabin of the truck. Do you remember that?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Judging by your statement, the one you gave to the Prosecutor in 2001, and I'm going to say what you said there, and you can confirm it or not. "The driver was on the left at the wheel, then the second person next to him was Nihad Buric"; is that right? According to what you said. No, I beg your pardon, you said you were sitting right next to the driver; is that right?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: And then to your right there was Nihad Buric; is that right? And then in the next place, right by the right-hand door was Saric Ermin; is that right? Ermin Saric?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Can we therefore conclude that you were sitting somewhere in the middle of the truck, closer to the left-hand side to the wheel, centre left?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I was closer to the right, because the driver was a little angry and said, "Move over," because he couldn't shift gears, because of us.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Do you think -- are you saying that you were sitting towards the left or right of centre?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: No, right of centre. Further from the wheel.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: In response to a Prosecution question, you said that you had seen a flash from a house at Stotina; is that right?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: I'll read out what you said about that in the statement you gave in 2001, which you confirmed today as being your very own statement. You said, "The hits must have been shot from the direction of Stotina," that was your conclusion. And then you also said that before you were wounded you did not know that the HVO had positions at Stotina. So let's break that up into parts. First, is it true as you said previously that before that incident took place you did not know that the HVO allegedly had positions at Stotina?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I did not know they had, no.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: You didn't, right. Now, is it true and correct that in your statement of 2001, you said that the hits must have come from the direction of Stotina?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes, correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Is it also correct that you made no mention of having seen any flash from the place or house at Stotina that the hit had come from, there's nothing about this flash in your statement; is that right?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I apologise, but I told the story quite a few times.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: All right. Let me ask the question in a different way then. In your previous statement, given to the Prosecution in 2001, you said that you consider - shall I put it that way - that your conclusion was that the hit had come from Stotina; is that right? Is it right that when you gave your statement you made no mention of having seen a flash from a house at Stotina?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Possibly they didn't ask me.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: So you think they didn't ask you about that? Is that your answer?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: But, Witness, you were expressly asked where the hits could have come from. You were asked that precisely?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: What do you want me to answer now?

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Were you asked where the shots came from? That was the contents, the main subject of the interview.

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Well, I can't remember now.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Do you agree then that it was for the first time today here in court that you stated that you had seen a flash coming from the house?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: I don't agree with that, no.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: So you think you said that earlier, before?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Sir, I apologise, but I talked a lot about this. Many people came to ask me what had happened, how things had happened before I came to The Hague as well, from the civilian victims I was asked about all that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: Since you mentioned, and from this answer, it would appear that a lot of people asked you about those events. Let's go back to that then. From the documents that I have provided for -- to us by the Prosecution, you were first interviewed in detail about the incident when you were wounded on the 29th of August, 2001, in Mostar; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ANEL HELJIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Kovacic, you are spending a lot of time on this. You know that the witness took the solemn declaration and that he is answering under oath. And as far as we Judges are concerned, that carries weight. If other interviews and testimonies fail to mention this -- but what is important for us is what is said here in the courtroom under the solemn declaration.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I just wanted to check if he had perhaps told the investigators that and it wasn't recorded, because I would like to draw attention to the fact that the interview in 2001 was only devoted to this particular incident. That is the only subject that was discussed.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Sir, the flash that you saw, did you -- is this the first time you recounted that incident or did you mention the flash to a lot of other people, maybe even to the investigators of the OTP? To the best of your recollections.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] As far as I remember, I did talk about that to other people too. I can't remember if I actually told them that or whether they asked me, but I know that we in the truck discussed that too, myself and my two friends, that there was a flash from up there.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your friend Nihad, who was also wounded and sitting next to you but not as badly as yourself, did he see the flash as well?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, he said he did. That's correct. And he pointed to it. He saw where it came from. He pointed to the place where he saw it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] All right. Mr. Bos, Nihad, the other victim, did he make a statement or not?

utterances.speaker: MR. BOS
utterances.text: I would have to double-check. I'm not 100 per cent sure. We have another statement from Mr. Mustafa Buric, but I can't say 100 per cent. I would have to double-check. I don't want to say this here on the record.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And Mustafa Buric saw nothing? Because he went into the building. Anyway, you're saying Witness, that your friend sitting next to you saw the flash just like you did.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.
